inputs.prompt: Read PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md in the current directory and resolve the issue. Edit source files only (do NOT touch tests). After editing, run the relevant tests to verify your fix passes. Do NOT modify PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md and do NOT commit. When finished, print a one-line summary and exit.
